description: Complete pinned hard-risk limit set (spec section 16), consumed by the Rust risk engine (rust/risk). FAIL-CLOSED: a missing or invalid limit puts the engine in reject-everything mode; every decision is emitted as a RiskEvent (schemas/risk_event.schema.json) to a JSONL audit log; decisions are deterministic and replayable. duplicate_order_window_ns 0 means the entire session; order rate is a per-strategy event-time token bucket (rate max_order_rate_per_sec, capacity order_rate_burst).
